name: Bahrain International Circuit
layout: Grand Prix circuit (F1 and WEC 8 Hours)

sources.geometry: OpenStreetMap raceway ways 4818385, 881756729, 881756728 ("Grand Prix Circuit"), (c) OSM contributors; start gantry located on Esri World Imagery
sources.width: published: circuit facts ~15 m typical, start/finish straight ~20 m and wide Turn 1 approach (section mapping, not measured)
sources.elevation: Copernicus GLO-30 DSM (https://copernicus-dem-30m.s3.amazonaws.com/), rolling 25th percentile (+-45 m) against grandstand/building spikes, then robust-median smoothed
sources.camber: none (30 m DEM cannot resolve crossfall)
sources.pit: OSM way 187123422 "Pit Lane" (east side of the start straight)
sources.trim: medium downforce, traction-limited stop-start layout with long straights: Spa-like wing level
sources.pitLimit: FIA F1 Sporting Regulations (80 km/h); WEC 8 Hours of Bahrain pit-lane limit 60 km/h (FIA WEC Sporting Regulations)
sources.pitLoss: F1 public strategy previews (~22-24 s total loss, one of the longer pit lanes)

notes: Same Grand Prix layout used by F1 and WEC. No F1 sprint in 2026. Turn numbering per official 15-turn map, apexes from curvature peaks.
